Hi all —

Thanks for the intro, Jasmine. MerchantWave — welcome. Quick notes from ACE:
- Please use the ACE portal link to start the registration; that preserves tracking and speeds approvals: https://console.aws.amazon.com/partnernetwork/ace/registration/abc123
- Required items: listing draft, company legal name, AWS account ID (you provided 987654321098), revenue contact, SOC2/ISO attestation (if available) and a technical artifact pack (AMI/container image details, deployment guide).
- For telemetry retention, ACE recommends a minimum of 90 days for audit logs for co-sell eligibility; 180+ is preferable for larger customers.

I’ve attached a registration checklist and a one-page PDM/PSM intro template (ace-registration-checklist.xlsx). Kimberly — happy to take the lead on initial review once MerchantWave completes the sheet.

Confirming Thu 10/22 13:00 PT for the handshake — I’ll join as well.

Regards,
Priya Banerjee
AWS ACE Program Manager
priya@amazon.com

Attachment: ace-registration-checklist.xlsx (editable)

Kimberly / Karthik / Aditya —

Recap from the intake thread and Priya’s checklist: MerchantWave is committed to pursuing ACE co-sell. They provided AWS account 987654321098 and a vendor profile. Priya shared the portal link and an editable checklist (attached to external thread).

Please own these action items before the handshake (Thu 10/22 13:00 PT):

- Karthik: prepare a one-page PDM talking points doc that covers joint deployment patterns (VPC, private endpoints, telemetry) and our recommended quantization/latency guidance for a MerchantWave-sized deployment
- Aditya: coordinate with Solutions to get a short demo environment we can show during joint call (minimal dataset, pre-configured inference runtime)

Also flag any procurement/legal blockers you see so Sanjay’s legal team can be looped. I’ll join the handshake and manage the agenda.

Thanks —
